groups.call_boundary: JSProxy::SetInstance/GetInstance; JsKVStoreResultSet NAPI getters; Create/CloseResultSet and GetEntry paths.
groups.cia_assessment: Controlled TSan proves owner data race/UB in the modeled component shape. Product crash/DoS, returned-entry integrity, confidentiality and privilege effects unmeasured.

controls.positive: passed: generic race and close_get_entry TSan 3/3

groups.publication_order_and_happens_before: GetResultSet execute calls SetInstance; completion returns the wrapper. Sync methods copy GetInstance. CloseResultSet execute calls GetInstance then SetInstance(nullptr). Completion serialization does not order execute against a later sync JS call.
groups.sensitive_operation: Distributed KV result-set lifetime and Entry retrieval through a native shared_ptr wrapper.
groups.thread_or_event_queue_model: Sync ResultSet methods use GetCbInfoSync on the NAPI/JS call context. GetResultSet/CloseResultSet use NapiQueue::AsyncWork: execute runs on the NAPI worker pool and complete on the JS/NAPI queue. The same JSProxy owner can be read by a sync call while async CloseResultSet clears it.
groups.title: RC-JSPROXY
groups.trigger_conditions_and_race_window: Source-visible sequence getResultSet -> closeResultSet -> immediate getEntry/getCount before async close execute completes. The controlled Harness models this exact overlap.

groups.publication_order_and_happens_before: GetOrCreateRemoteCommandExecutor publishes the executor; NotifyDeviceOnline checks GetChannel and calls SetChannel under RemoteCommandManager::mutex_. CreateChannelIfNeeded writes ptrChannel_ under RemoteCommandExecutor::recursive_mutex_; ProcessOneCommand/ExecuteRemoteCommand read it. Different locks leave no proven happens-before edge.
groups.sensitive_operation: Remote RPC channel construction, connection lifecycle and remote token-sync command execution.
groups.thread_or_event_queue_model: Send command work is posted to TokenSyncManagerService::GetSendEventHandler() on an FFRT EventRunner; device online/offline enters through SoftBus device callbacks and socket session callbacks. Exact callback thread identities and common serialization are not proven.
groups.title: RC-REMOTE-CHANNEL
groups.trigger_conditions_and_race_window: Device-online channel creation versus send-runner processing or socket callback use, with offline release/remove as a third event. Feasible product schedule and rate are not established.
